# PrioScout Swab Report

![](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQ17T5GtEiY8l0gX_l8AvlgKL54z92lDOwV9A&s){width="100%"}

```{r Initialize, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
calcs <- read.csv("data/calculations.csv", check.names = FALSE)
results <- read.csv("data/results.csv", check.names = FALSE)

sample_number <- nrow(filter(results, !(`Sample IDs` %in% c("N", "P"))))
```

<!-- This project consisted of `{r} sample_number` PrioScout swabs. -->

## Methodology
Swabs were run in 4 replicates. Results were compared against the negative plate control using a t-test. Metrics analyzed were maxpoint ratio (MPR) and maximum slope (MS). The p-values for each metric must be ≤ 0.05 and more than 50% of replicates must have crossed a threshold of twice the background fluorescence for a sample to be considered detected. If a sample was only positive for one or two of the three metrics, it was designated as "weak suspect" or "strong suspect", respectively.

```{r, echo=FALSE}

background_list <- list(
  "Detected" = "#99023B",
  "Strong Suspect" = "#7C2C62",
  "Weak Suspect" = "#5F5589",
  "Not Detected" = "white"
)

text_list = list(
  "Detected" = "white",
  "Strong Suspect" = "white",
  "Weak Suspect" = "white",
  "Not Detected" = "black"
)

results %>%
  select(c(1, 18:22)) %>%
  filter(!(`Sample IDs` %in% c("N", "P"))) %>%
  rename_all(~ str_replace(., "_", " ")) %>%
  mutate_all(
    ~ cell_spec(
      .,
      background = background_list[Result],
      color = text_list[Result]
    )
  ) %>%
  kable(
    booktabs = TRUE,
    longtable = TRUE,
    linesep = "",
    format = "latex",
    escape = FALSE,
    align = "c",
    caption = "Results of RT-QuIC testing. Samples were given a result of 'Not Detected', 'Weak Suspect', 'Strong Suspect', or 'Detected' if it was positive for zero, one, two, or three metrics, respectively."
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    # full_width = TRUE,
    latex_options = c("hold_position", "repeat_header")
  )
```
